Created by Jenny McClendon, MS, PT, CGCP, a fitness enthusiast with over 30 years experience in the fitness industry. As a licensed Physical Therapist, it is of highest importance to me that these exercises are safe, easy to follow, and appropriate!  I have a HUGE love for teaching seniors and beginners!  It is for all levels, sizes, and ages.  I am known for being real, personable, encouraging, and energetic - you will feel comfortable doing these videos! I add videos regularly so you can do them in the comfort of your own home, on your own time, and at your own pace. 

Jenny's Fit Bunch: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHufaoaq1VqjHvnv8zvg9pQ/join
Website:  www.jennyfitstart.com
Collaborations: collabs@jennyfitstart.com
Questions: connect@jennyfitstart.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/jennyfitstart
Instagram: @jennyfitstart
**For those who have graciously offered to donate in exchange for taking these classes for free:  Venmo (@Jenny-McClendon), Pay Pal (jmcclendon@nc.rr.com)
